references.text: God's original instructions to Moses on building the ark of the covenant with its mercy seat and carrying poles.
The description of how Bezalel actually made the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat, and the carrying poles.
Moses is instructed to place the ark of the covenant in the tabernacle and hang the veil before it.
Moses places the testimony in the ark, sets the poles on it, and puts the mercy seat over it.
Instructions on how the ark of the covenant should be covered and carried with its poles.
God spoke to Moses from above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim, which were over the ark of the covenant.
Moses speaks about the new stone tablets that were placed in the ark he had made.
The letter to the Hebrews describes the ark of the covenant and the mercy seat with the cherubim overshadowing it.
Describes the transition from the making of the ark to its actual assembly in the tent of meeting.
Connects the instruction to make the ark with the actual completion of those same components.
Demonstrates the fulfillment of God's specific instructions regarding the ark and the mercy seat.
Links the original instruction for assembling the ark with its actual completion.
Connects the physical making of the ark with its theological function as God's meeting place.
